what_changed: PO-5520 (200 BL-12 boilers, originally due day 7) will now ship either as 80 units on day 7 plus 120 units on day 21 (Option A), or all 200 units together on day 13 (Option B).

options.name: Option A (80 on day 7, 120 on day 21)

decisions_for_a_person: Choose between Option A (puts order O-2205, 4 days late, 5 units short, late_penalty=true, at risk) and Option B (puts order O-2203, 1 day late, 40 units short, late_penalty=true, at risk) within the supplier's 3-business-day deadline.
If no decision is made in time, Marlow Metalworks will default to Option B, risking O-2203.
supplier_questions: Which shipping option (A or B) would Copperline like for PO-5520, to be confirmed within three business days?
